description: This Java class 'SetupProfileFragment' handles the initiation of managed profile provisioning in an Android application, including UI interactions and intent handling for device management.

classes.name: SetupProfileFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages the process of provisioning a managed profile on an Android device.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of SetupProfileFragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up click listener for the profile setup button.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, triggers profile provisioning.

methods.name: provisionManagedProfile
methods.description: Starts the managed profile provisioning process via intent.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the provisioning activity, shows success or failure message.
